Lena (People Ops): Hey team — pilot idea: 'Peer Café' pop-ups the week of May 10. We pair handwritten recognition cards with a small bento voucher + sticker pack. Run in SF, NYC, and London offices. Budget approved up to $1,500/city. Volunteers to help coordinate vendors, printing, and drop logistics?
Sam: love it. Are these in-office only or do we have a remote plan?
Lena (People Ops): Good q — in-office primary. For remote we'll send digital lunch vouchers (small $10 e-gift) and a printable card PDF.
Priya: Who's handling printed cards? We can do a local print shop in each city. I can quote SF and NYC this week.
Ethan: I can take London print & assembly. Also can pick up stickers from vendor if needed.
Rory: I have a contact at BentoBox Events + a local stationery print shop in London (paged Rory). They can do 150 cards + envelopes same-day.
Kelsey: How many kits per office?
Lena (People Ops): Target ~120 kits SF, 100 NYC, 80 London for the pilot. We expect some leftover but want broad coverage.
Sam: timeline?
Lena (People Ops): Proposed timeline:
```
- May 1: finalize volunteer leads and vendors
- May 4: confirm card design + sticker pack
- May 6: print & assemble
- Week of May 10: in-office pop-ups (1 day per office)
- May 17: send remote e-gifts + PDF cards
```
Sam: ok. Can we get a quick cost breakdown per kit?
Priya: I'll estimate — printing $0.60/card, envelope $0.10, sticker pack $1.50, voucher $10 => ~ $12.2 per remote-inclusive kit. With assembly/logistics and vendor fees looks close to approval.
Ethan: Shipping/pickup windows in London are tight; will need Facilities sign-off for extra storage day.
FacilitiesBot: FYI — please request a temporary storage pass for vendor drop-offs via the facilities portal 72h before delivery.
Rory: Volunteer list from me: happy to own vendor coord (London) and pickup.
Kelsey: I can run NYC assembly day and volunteer ops help on the pop-up day.
Sam: I can do SF vendor and volunteer scheduling.
Lena (People Ops): Amazing — volunteers: Sam (SF), Kelsey (NYC), Ethan + Rory (London), Priya (printing quotes). I'll own design and remote e-gifts.
Lena (People Ops): Quick checklist for volunteers: 
```
- confirm vendor + cost
- share pickup time & storage plan
- confirm assembly volunteers (min 2 people)
- create sign-up sheet for recipients
- coordinate pop-up table + tiny card-writing station
```
Kelsey: sign-up sheet? can we use the AllHands event form or a short Google sheet?
Lena (People Ops): Google sheet is fine — I'll create and share link. Also will prepare a printable card PDF for remote folks.
Priya: I'll post vendor quotes here by Friday.
Sam: tagging @here in SF once schedule set for volunteers. :thumbsup:
Ethan: FYI — sticker vendor ETA 4 business days, ordered if we get final art by EOD tomorrow.
Lena (People Ops): Perfect. Last items: who will handle handwritten pens/markers on pop-up day? Suggest office hosts supply 2 packs each.
Rory: I'll bring a marker set for London.
Kelsey: Facilities — can you reserve a 2-hour spot in NYC kitchen and a small table?
FacilitiesBot: Reservation request received. Please check the facilities portal for confirmation by EOD.
Lena (People Ops): Thanks all. Action items recap: Priya (quotes), Sam (SF vendor + volunteers), Kelsey (NYC assembly + space), Ethan & Rory (London print & pickup), Lena (design + remote vouchers + sign-up sheet). I'll update this thread with the Google sign-up and the printable PDF when ready. :coffee::smile:
